templates.title: OpenTools
templates.name: opentools
templates.description: PDF, image, audio, video, subtitle, data, text and QR utilities that run entirely in the visitor's browser. Files are read into memory by the browser, processed there with Web Workers and WebAssembly, and offered back as a download — they are never sent to this container, so they never touch its disk and never appear in a backup of it. The server serves pages and does none of the work. Needs no internet access at runtime.
templates.note: Published on 127.0.0.1 by default because the image ships no TLS and no authentication. To serve it beyond this host, put a TLS-terminating reverse proxy in front of it and set OPENTOOLS_AUTH_USER and OPENTOOLS_AUTH_PASSWORD. See https://github.com/mgbuilderos/opentools/blob/main/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md

env.name: OPENTOOLS_AUTH_USER
env.label: Access gate username (optional, leave empty for no prompt)

env.name: OPENTOOLS_AUTH_PASSWORD
env.label: Access gate password (optional, required if a username is set)
